name: k8s-crashloop-diagnostics
description: Diagnose Kubernetes pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff or Error states. Use this skill when pods fail to start, crash unexpectedly, or report OOMKilled events.
observed_benefit: Isolates root cause of pod failures in under 2 minutes. Saves ~30 minutes of manual log searching.
author: @devops-guild

name: pull-request-security-check
description: Inspect git diffs for security vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, and missing authentication guards. Use this skill when reviewing pull requests or preparing code for review.
observed_benefit: Finds missing authorization checks and exposed test keys before human code review. Saves ~20 minutes per PR.
author: @appsec-team

name: edge-case-unit-test-generator
description: Generate boundary and failure condition tests for existing functions. Use this skill when adding unit tests, increasing test coverage, or testing edge cases.
observed_benefit: Generates boundary condition tests (nulls, empty strings, timeouts). Increases test coverage by ~25%.
author: @qa-guild
